tokens.name: app
tokens.usage: Page background (Atlassian elevation.surface). Content sits directly on it; cards add a border.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the top bar, the side nav, tables, inputs, modals and drawers.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: board columns, table hover, read-only fields, code, input hover (Atlassian elevation.surface.sunken).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text (Atlassian color.text).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, nav items, button text on neutral fill (color.text.subtle).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, column headers, captions, breadcrumbs (color.text.subtlest). 5.0:1 on white.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels only. 3.4:1: never for information a person must read.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers inside cards and table rows.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Card and table outlines, top bar and side nav edges (color.border).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, checkboxes and radios (color.border.input), 3:1 so fields read as fields.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover on menu items, subtle buttons, rows (color.background.neutral.subtle.hovered).

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Fill of default buttons, tags, count badges (color.background.neutral).

tokens.name: neutral-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of default buttons (color.background.neutral.hovered).

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, option, row, tab, page (color.background.selected).

tokens.name: selected-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a selected background (color.text.selected).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, checked checkboxes and radios, the active tab bar, focused progress (color.background.brand.bold).

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus outline and focused input border (color.border.focused).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success text: Paid, Lunas, In stock.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Background of success lozenges and messages.

tokens.name: ok-line
tokens.usage: Border of success callouts where a border is needed.

tokens.name: ok-solid
tokens.usage: Bold success: switch on, bold success lozenge.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text: Partly paid, Low stock, Due soon.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Background of warning lozenges and messages.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Border of warning callouts where a border is needed.

tokens.name: warn-solid
tokens.usage: Bold warning: bold warning lozenge, the warning banner. Text on it is on-warn.

tokens.name: on-warn
tokens.usage: Text and icons on warn-solid (dark on yellow in both themes).

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Error text, Overdue, negative amounts, danger labels.

tokens.name: bad-tint
tokens.usage: Background of error lozenges and messages.

tokens.name: bad-line
tokens.usage: Border of error callouts where a border is needed.

tokens.name: bad-solid
tokens.usage: Danger buttons, unread dots, urgent badges.

tokens.name: on-bad
tokens.usage: Text on bad-solid.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: In-progress / submitted text.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Background of in-progress lozenges and info messages.

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: Border of info callouts where a border is needed.

tokens.name: discovery
tokens.usage: New / suggested by Raka (color.text.discovery).

tokens.name: discovery-tint
tokens.usage: Background of new / AI-suggested lozenges and messages.

tokens.name: disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Disabled button and field fill; label in faint.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Categorical chart colour 1 (Atlassian data-viz palette). Single-series charts use chart-1; categories take colours in order. Never the only carrier of meaning: legends and labels name every series.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Categorical chart colour 2 (Atlassian data-viz palette). Single-series charts use chart-1; categories take colours in order. Never the only carrier of meaning: legends and labels name every series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Categorical chart colour 3 (Atlassian data-viz palette). Single-series charts use chart-1; categories take colours in order. Never the only carrier of meaning: legends and labels name every series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Categorical chart colour 4 (Atlassian data-viz palette). Single-series charts use chart-1; categories take colours in order. Never the only carrier of meaning: legends and labels name every series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Categorical chart colour 5 (Atlassian data-viz palette). Single-series charts use chart-1; categories take colours in order. Never the only carrier of meaning: legends and labels name every series.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Categorical chart colour 6 (Atlassian data-viz palette). Single-series charts use chart-1; categories take colours in order. Never the only carrier of meaning: legends and labels name every series.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Rangka teal, brand surfaces only: Raka's body, the logo, the design-system cover, sign-in and marketing pages, the app icon. Never a UI state (not selection, focus, links, actions or status).

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Deeper teal for Raka's seam and bolts and for brand text on marketing pages. Not used in the product UI.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Light teal for brand compositions (the cover, marketing). Not used in the product UI.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: Omilo's spark and Raka's hard hat. A mark colour, never text.

tokens.name: helmet
tokens.usage: Raka's hard hat: an alias of spark, so Omilo and Rangka share one amber.

tokens.name: field-base
tokens.usage: Neutral avatar background.

tokens.name: field-indigo
tokens.usage: Avatar and tag tint; text on it is ink.

tokens.name: field-sky
tokens.usage: Avatar and tag tint; text on it is ink.

tokens.name: field-sage
tokens.usage: Avatar and tag tint; text on it is ink.

tokens.name: field-amber
tokens.usage: Avatar and tag tint; text on it is ink.

tokens.name: field-rose
tokens.usage: Avatar and tag tint; text on it is ink.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals, drawers and the command menu (color.blanket).

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: Switch knob.

tokens.name: viewer
tokens.usage: Image viewer background: always near-black so photos read true. Text on it is #fafaf9.

tokens.name: mascot-ink
tokens.usage: Mascot eyes, mouth and outlines; the same in both themes because it sits on the mascot's own body colour.

families.sans: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Ubuntu, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, Menlo, "Segoe UI Mono", "Ubuntu Mono", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Brand moments only: the cover, sign-in, marketing. Product screens use h1.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The product or company name beside the Raka mark in the sidebar.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title in the page header (Atlassian heading.large).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Modal titles, dashboard and settings section titles (heading.medium).

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, form section titles, drawer section titles (heading.small).

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: One-sentence intro under a page title, in muted.
styles.sample: Catat penjualan dan stok dalam satu tempat.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text, table cells, inputs, menu items (body).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Help text under fields, captions, timestamps (body.small).
styles.sample: Faktur yang sudah diajukan tidak bisa diubah.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels above the control, in ink-2; required fields get a red * after the label (Atlassian label).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Lozenges and tiny uppercase labels above stats.

styles.name: group-label
styles.usage: Side-nav section headings, uppercase, in muted.

styles.name: num-stat
styles.usage: Statistic values on number cards (tabular figures).

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Amounts and quantities, tabular figures, right-aligned in columns.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap in chips, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Button icon gap, label-to-input gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; workspace inset padding; nav item padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card grid gap, table cell right padding, sidebar item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, topbar side padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding on soft callouts.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page top padding, gap between dashboard sections and page-header rows.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Spare step between 24 and 32.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Spare step; page side padding is 40px (space-6 + space-4) on desktop, 16px on phones.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page bottom padding.

tokens.name: r-xs
tokens.usage: Lozenges, checkboxes, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, calendar cells, tags.

tokens.name: r-btn
tokens.usage: Buttons (Atlassian border.radius).

tokens.name: r
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, segmented items, nav items.

tokens.name: r-md
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, popovers, menus, flags (toasts).

tokens.name: r-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, number cards, board columns, messages.

tokens.name: r-dialog
tokens.usage: Modals and the command menu.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: the ask bar, count badges, offline banner.

shadow.note: Atlassian elevation: flat surfaces with borders; raised for cards that move, overlay for anything that floats.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Top bar bottom edge when content scrolls under it.

tokens.name: shadow-seg
tokens.usage: Selected segmented item (elevation.shadow.raised).

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Raised cards: board cards, dragged items (elevation.shadow.raised).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px focus-blue ring (Atlassian color.border.focused).

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, selects, date pickers, popovers (elevation.shadow.overlay).

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Modals, drawers, the command menu.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Flags (notifications).

tokens.name: focus-soft
tokens.usage: Focused input: the border turns focus-blue and this inner line makes it 2px.

size.note: Atlassian sizes: 32px buttons, 36px fields, 56px top navigation, 240px side navigation.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, small inputs, table toolbar icons.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Buttons, selects in toolbars, top-bar controls.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Text fields and selects in forms.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons, POS forms, sign-in.

tokens.name: pos-key
tokens.usage: POS keypad keys and the pay key: thumb-sized for counter use.

tokens.name: topbar
tokens.usage: Top navigation height.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Side navigation width; 0 when collapsed.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content on very wide screens.

tokens.name: dialog-w
tokens.usage: Confirm dialog width; form dialogs use 560px.

tokens.name: drawer-w
tokens.usage: Drawer width (720px for wide).

tokens.name: command-w
tokens.usage: Command menu width.

tokens.name: menu-w
tokens.usage: Context menu and dropdown minimum width.

tokens.name: toast-w
tokens.usage: Flag (toast) width, bottom-left.

meta.source: Atlassian Design System tokens (colour, elevation, typography, radius) on Rangka component structure; brand-* teal kept for Raka and the logo
